g.text: GITOPS MONOREPO -- FROM git push TO PRODUCTION (github.com/rosaliei/gitops-monorepo)
yellow = CI (GitHub Actions) green = CD (Git + ArgoCD) red box = the real file in the repo
changes: # paths-filter -> only the apps that changed
deploy-dev: # main only -> commit to environments/dev
run: npm ci && npm run lint && npm test
tags: sha-<commit> (+ x.y.z on a release)
5) hand over { app, tag, digest, new_release }
CI: 0.2.0 not in registry -> tag the build as 0.2.0
plan: # take qa tag + digest, verify in GHCR
# rollback = same workflow with an older version
# admission policy: kubectl edit in demo-* is DENIED
ONE-TIME BY HAND: make up -> kind cluster + ArgoCD (helm) + kubectl apply -f argocd/bootstrap/root-app.yaml
After that, every change reaches the cluster through Git only. Details: docs/manual-steps.md and docs/automation-steps.md
